title: Q-TICK-DEPLOY: deploy ultrastable-tick with the AI binding from a workflow
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every push to main touching seed/worker
**Done check:** grep:.github/workflows/deploy-tick.yml::deploy
**Status:** open

The tick worker binds only D1 and no workflow deploys it. Add a deploy workflow (built-in token route plus a cloud-session route), bind AI, probe the live route. Filed at thread close; the executor works it in driver order.
